svg.title: Skills: load SKILL.md instructions on demand
svg.desc: At the start of every run, Skills reads each SKILL.md in the configured libraries from the run's workspace, such as .agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md, and puts a catalog of skill names and descriptions in the model's instructions. When a skill is useful, the model calls load_capability with its name and gets back a "# Skill: code-review" heading, the skill's directory and the Markdown body of SKILL.md.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
